messages:
maria_csm: Heads up — small cohort of new tenants (mostly trials onboarded last week) are seeing onboarding verification webhooks delayed 2–8 minutes and intermittent embedding ingest 503s. Flagging potential renewal risk for a few high-touch trials. I'm starting outreach drafts.

siva_eng: I can repro. Elevated queue length on dedicated-pool-3 after yesterday's runtime tweak; KV cache miss rate spiked. Could be batching kernel regression. Opening bridge in 10.

emma_cs: Drafting customer note. Suggest offering 1 complimentary enablement session + 10% billing credit for affected accounts. Need impacted list and ETA so we don't overpromise.

jake_se: Will pull impacted tenants by tag "trial-high-touch" + last 7d token spikes. ETA ~15m.

ops_bot: Incident INC-20250315 created — assigned to siva_eng. Severity: Sev2. Autoscaling triggered on pool; fallback to general-pool routed ~84% of overflow requests.

lisa_cust: @maria_csm we already got one customer DM asking for status. Can we share a short ETA the CS reps can use?

siva_eng: Quick update: root cause looks like an inadvertent rollback of batching optimization -> increased memory pressure -> sporadic 503s and delayed webhook acknowledgements. Hotfix: re-enable previous batching kernel and increase pool headroom. Pushing patch now, expected ~10–15m to stabilize.

paul_csm: I'll prioritize outreach to 7 renewal-risk accounts once patch is confirmed. Proposed outreach outline: 1) brief apology, 2) simple non-technical summary of cause, 3) mitigation steps taken, 4) credit + enablement offer, 5) ask to confirm any missing data. I can join calls this afternoon.

emma_cs: Draft message v1:

"Hi <Name>,
We’re sorry — your onboarding was delayed due to an internal runtime regression that affected a small set of accounts. We’ve deployed a patch and processing is resuming. We’d like to offer a complimentary 30m enablement session and a 10% credit for affected usage. Can we book a time today or tomorrow?"

Thoughts?

jake_se: Looks good. Add a one-line checklist of what customers might see (delayed webhook acks, missing embeddings, transient errors) and a link to the status page for live updates.

maria_csm: +1. Also we need a concise RCA paragraph for follow-up mails: cause, immediate mitigation, next actions (gating, alerts, capacity), and owner contacts.

siva_eng: Action owners: rollback-guard — eng-runtime (siva_eng), KV-miss alert — eng-sre (jake_se), deploy gating policy updates — eng-platform (siva_eng + jake_se). ETA for alerts and gating: 72 hours.

paul_csm: Once patch is green, please post the final impacted list with precise time-window so CS can adjust renewal-risk scoring and record notes in the CRM. I’ll queue calendar invites for anyone who accepts the enablement offer.

emma_cs: I’ll prepare the credit wording and loop in legal for signoff.

maria_csm: Thanks everyone — please post a confirm when the patch is live and send the final list. I’ll push the customer drafts afterward and start the high-touch outreach. :heart:
